notes: Maya is the one tradition where a fully mechanical worked-example check is available today: the correlation anchors are published, unambiguous, and independently reproduced by two institutional converters. These cases verify the kernel end to end - Long Count decomposition, both cycle formulae, and the JDN mapping - against values no practitioner disputes.

claims.author_states: The era base falls on 4 Ajaw.

examples.location: Correlation constant 584283; reproduced by the NMAI and FAMSI converters
examples.description: The completion of 13 baktuns, 21 December 2012. Chosen because its Calendar Round position is widely misquoted as 4 Ajaw 8 Kumk'u - the era-base position - when the Haab has in fact advanced 280 days to 3 K'ank'in. A kernel that returns 8 Kumk'u here has silently reused the era base.

claims.author_states: The Tzolk'in position is 4 Ajaw, repeating the era base because 1872000 is an exact multiple of 260.
The Haab position is 3 K'ank'in, NOT 8 Kumk'u: 1872000 is not a multiple of 365, so the Haab advances 280 days from the era base.
